verdict.rationale: Undermind is an AI research assistant, so letting users connect external MCP servers for it to use is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence, however, documents only the opposite role: Undermind runs as an MCP server that other clients (Cursor, VS Code, Claude, Codex, Copilot) connect to. Nothing shows Undermind itself accepting or calling third-party MCP servers, and server-side evidence does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
